# `aitbc ipfs upload`

Upload a file to IPFS and return its CID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ipfs upload [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--file` | path | — | yes | File to upload |
| `--pin` | flag | `true` | no | Pin uploaded content |
| `--name` | text | — | no | Human-readable name for the upload |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ipfs upload --file <file>
```
